name: performance_process_query_time_with_mocks
description: Performance test: measure time for process_query with mocked retrieval and LLM to ensure it completes quickly (< 1s).
input: Create ElectricVehicleTypeAgent(); patch agent._retriever.retrieve_chunks to AsyncMock(return_value=['chunk1']); patch agent._llm.generate_response to AsyncMock(return_value='Short answer'); measure elapsed time for await agent.process_query('Compute EV types').
